description: Use this when the user wants XcutAI's agents to write for their brand: Reels, TikTok and Shorts scripts, YouTube scripts, Facebook posts, Meta ad copy, hooks, captions or plans, using their brand memory, imported posts and XcutAI's library of formats that performed. The conversation is saved to their canvas. Pick `agent` for the platform, or auto. Token-billed (typically 1-26 credits). Longer turns return a `job_id`. Do not use for writing unrelated to the user's social media or marketing content.

agent.description: Which XcutAI writer to use: auto (picks from the request), instagram, tiktok, youtube_script, youtube_shorts, facebook, meta_ad or general. Default auto.
agent.title: Agent

canvas_id.description: Optional. Leave it out unless the user names a canvas: XcutAI then uses their "From AI apps" canvas, where imports also land. Ids come from xcut_list_canvases.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

item_ids.description: Only use these canvas items (default: the whole canvas).
item_ids.title: Item Ids

request.description: What to write, as the user would ask in the canvas chat.
request.title: Request

name: xcut_write_content
title: Write with an XcutAI agent
